    other_mean = adata[~mask].X.mean(axis=0).A1 if hasattr(adata[~mask].X, 'A') else adata[~mask].X.mean(axis=0)
    
    # Calculate fold change
    fc = cluster_mean / (other_mean + 1e-10)
    fc_log2 = np.log2(fc)
    
    # Get top 10 upregulated genes

    print(f"\n=== Cluster {cluster} ===")
    print(f"Cell count: {np.sum(mask)}")
    print("Top 10 marker genes (log2FC):")
    for gene, fc in zip(top_genes, top_fc):
